verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
We're looking to the promise of old
That if we turn and humble ourselves
You will come and heal our land
You will come, You will come

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We're looking to the promise You made
That if we turn and look to Your face
You will come and heal our land
You will come, You will come
To us

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Lord, send revival, start with me
For I am one of unclean lips
And my eyes have seen the King
Your glory I have glimpsed
Send revival, start with me

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
We're looking to the promise of old
That if we pray and humble ourselves
We're looking to the promise You made
That if we turn and seek to Your face

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines: God, would You come and heal our hearts

verse.name: v1f
verse.lines:
You will come and heal our land
You will come and heal our land

verse.name: v1g
verse.lines:
You will come and heal Your church
You will come and heal Your church

verse.name: v1h
verse.lines:
We're looking to the promise of old
That if we turn and humble ourselves
We're looking to the promise You made
That if we pray and look to Your face

verse.name: v1i
verse.lines:
You will come and hear our cries
You will come and hear our cries
